images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production material texture atlas for a painterly low-poly isometric tactics game. Generate a brand-new wide landscape opaque atlas, EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS BY 2 ROWS of equal rectangular swatches, full bleed, without any borders or gaps. Flat material samples only, no depicted trees, trunks in perspective, landscape, props or text. Hand-painted gouache-like brush facets with crisp readable leaf shapes and restrained micro-detail, muted natural palette, matte albedo without glossy highlights or cast shadows. Every panel fills its panel.
ROW 1 left to right:
1 Jungle canopy: dense large overlapping tropical leaves, forest emerald/olive midtones, deep green shadows, lime brush accents.
2 Jungle understory: broad elongated split fern/palm leaf vein pattern, dark green ground, readable pale central veins, downward-hanging strokes.
3 Dry grassland foliage: sparse warm olive/acacia small clustered leaves and straw-gold foliage, dry muted ochre-green palette, still alive rather than dead.
4 Wetland canopy: drooping narrow willow-like leaf clusters, soft sage/grey-green, long hanging brush strokes, restrained darker mossy areas.
ROW 2 left to right:
1 Snow conifer: layered downward conifer needle fans in deep blue spruce green, irregular small cool white snow patches resting on upper edges, needles still visible over at least 60 percent of panel.
2 Snow surface: powdery cool ivory snow with broad very subtle blue-grey brush variations, no objects or footprints.
3 Dry ground: short tawny grass strokes, warm khaki earth, low contrast, no pebbles or large plants.
4 Wet ground: dark olive moss and muted damp brown soil, sparse small blade strokes, no water pool or objects.
Exact straight panel boundaries at 25/50/75 percent across and 50 percent down. Every individual swatch should have similar color along its edges for repeat sampling. No labels, checkerboards, render frame, shadows, text or logos. This image will be directly UV-mapped to simple 3D geometry.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production ground material atlas for a low-poly painterly isometric tactics game. A wide landscape image divided EXACTLY into THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, six full-bleed equal panels with straight shared boundaries and NO gutters, outlines, labels, text or margin. These are flat top-down ground texture samples, no perspective, no islands, no cast shadows or objects. Broad hand-painted gouache brush facets and restrained short blade strokes, readable at game scale.
Top row left to right:
1 JUNGLE FLOOR: deep muted emerald/olive low tropical grass with moss, occasional restrained broad fallen-leaf dabs, cool damp dark green undertone. Dense and lush, low contrast.
2 TEMPERATE MEADOW: quiet muted olive and sage green grass, some khaki sunlit patches, sparse short straw strokes, close to traditional painted game grass. Never neon.
3 SNOW GRASS: predominantly soft ivory snow, irregular thin openings of muted cold green and pale straw grass, subtle blue-grey shading, a continuous snowy ground rather than isolated boulders or lumps.
Bottom row left to right:
1 DRY GRASSLAND: warm tawny khaki and straw-gold short grass, subdued dusty olive clumps, sparse visible ochre earth. No cracked desert, cactus, rocks or bush objects.
2 WETLAND GRASS: soft mossy dark olive ground, low sedge grass strokes, patches of dark moist brown earth, flattened irregular textures. No open water or tall reeds; the plants will be separate assets.
3 WETLAND MUD: muted dark umber wet soil with subtle sage/olive silt streaks, soft matte finish and modest damp tonal highlights, no strong shine, stones, footprints or standing water.
Every panel has fairly even color around all four edges for repeated UV sampling, no directional lighting gradients. Keep brushstroke and grass-blade scale consistent across the five vegetated panels. The texture boundaries are precisely at 1/3 and 2/3 image width and 1/2 height. No typography, labels, trees, scenery, animals, interface or framing.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: environment artist reference sheet for a painterly low-poly isometric tactics game. Landscape sheet, five clear labeled columns, warm grey neutral background, consistent orthographic three-quarter view and light from upper left. Title 'FOLIAGE FAMILIES'. Columns left to right labeled exactly 'JUNGLE', 'TEMPERATE', 'SNOW', 'DRY GRASSLAND', 'WETLANDS'. Each column has two complete isolated trees at common scale above, and two low plant clumps below. Leave air around every complete silhouette, do not overlap columns.
JUNGLE: tall buttressed trunk with wide umbrella of dense broad leaves; a gently curving palm with long arching fronds. Understory broad-leaf clump and fern.
TEMPERATE: mature rounded oak-like broadleaf, plus familiar layered green pine. Understory rounded shrub and meadow tufts.
SNOW: tall narrow snow-bearing spruce with downward branches; shorter open branching alpine pine. Understory low snow-capped evergreen scrub and sparse pale grass stems.
DRY GRASSLAND: flat spreading acacia-like canopy on forked trunk; shorter irregular twisted dry olive scrub tree. Understory straw tussocks and low dusty olive shrub.
WETLANDS: tall tapered cypress-like tree with a mildly flared root base; drooping willow with hanging leaf masses. Understory reeds and broad low marsh leaves.
Simple strong volumes suitable for low-poly translation, painterly skins provide almost all leaf and bark detail. Muted greens, khaki earth, cool snowy grey-blues. These must read as different botanical families, not the same tree recolored. No characters, buildings, scenery, model wireframes, bounding boxes, photorealism, plastic shine or novelty fantasy trees. Complete tree bases visible. The reference is a game-art design sheet, not final animation-ready sprites.

note: Generated images copied unchanged. These are new art-family assets; automatic terrain selection is a separate integration task.
